purpose: Cover US-18601 (the question set), US-18602 (the verb and the tools) and US-18603 (write-back and termination): computeQuestions turns every failing PO item into a question carrying its write-back; the CLI verb and the MCP tool emit the same object; the scripted loop converges; engineer edits never re-open the PO loop.
title: DEFINE step 3 PR 2: computeQuestions, the questions verb, MCP tools and loop convergence

testCases.description: On a fixture failing brief:openQuestions, skeleton:resolvedBy and stories:reqHasUs, computeQuestions(persona=productOwner) returns one entry per failing item with id, stage, check, itemId, heading, ask, answerKinds, writeBack and blocks intent.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/questions.test.js::AC-18601-1: openQuestions + resolvedBy + reqHasUs failing items each produce one question with the full shape

testCases.description: Two consecutive computeQuestions runs on the same tree return deep-equal questions[] ordered D1, D2, D4, D7 then by source span.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/questions.test.js::AC-18601-2: two runs are deep-equal and ordered D1, D2, D4, D7 then by source span

testCases.description: An open decision with two options and a default appears in optional[] with blocks build and not in questions[].
testCases.testPointer: test/query/questions.test.js::AC-18601-3: a two-option decision with a default appears in optional[], not questions[]

testCases.description: On a tree where levels.intentComplete.ok, computeQuestions(persona=productOwner) returns ok:true and empty questions[].
testCases.testPointer: test/query/questions.test.js::AC-18601-4: ok tree returns ok:true and empty questions[]

testCases.description: computeQuestions(persona=engineer) returns one entry per failing engineer item in failing stages with blocks build.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/questions.test.js::AC-18601-5: persona engineer returns engineer blockers in failing stages, blocks: build

testCases.description: computeQuestions throws a usage error naming productOwner and engineer when given any other persona value.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/questions.test.js::AC-18601-6: unknown persona throws naming the accepted values

testCases.description: computeQuestions never creates or modifies a file under rcf/ (mtime guard); every writeBack.command names a verb registered in the CLI help.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/questions.test.js::AC-18601-7: computeQuestions is pure; every writeBack.command names a registered verb

testCases.description: rcf define questions --json on a failing tree prints the computeQuestions object to stdout and exits 0.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/questions.test.js::AC-18602-1: --json on a failing tree prints the questions object and exits 0

testCases.description: Without --persona, the verb picks engineer on a profile whose register is engineer, else productOwner.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/questions.test.js::AC-18602-2: persona defaults from profile register

testCases.description: --stage skeleton --limit 2 caps questions[] to two D2 entries and reports remaining counting every D2 item.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/questions.test.js::AC-18602-3: --stage brief --limit 1 caps the output but keeps remaining honest

testCases.description: MCP tool rcf_define_questions returns structuredContent deep-equal to the verb's --json output on the same tree.
--persona architect exits 2 with the usage line naming productOwner and engineer.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/questions.test.js::AC-18602-5: --persona architect exits 2 naming productOwner and engineer

testCases.description: No file under rcf/ is created or modified during any invocation of rcf define questions.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/questions.test.js::AC-18602-6: questions writes nothing under rcf/

testCases.description: Scripted loop fixture: applying each writeBack and recomputing drives questions count strictly down each turn and to zero.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/questions-loop.test.js::AC-18603-1: scripted loop converges strictly to zero within a bounded number of turns

testCases.description: A statement resolved to a new REQ carrying description and domain passes skeleton:reqIntent and raises stories:reqHasUs once.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/questions-loop.test.js::AC-18603-2: a new REQ with description and domain passes reqIntent and asks reqHasUs once

testCases.description: At L1, adding [draft] entities, TAC stubs and interfaces leaves intentComplete.ok true and the PO question set empty.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/questions-loop.test.js::AC-18603-3: at L1 adding engineer-only draft entities keeps the PO question set empty

testCases.description: An openQuestion promoted to a decision with one option and no default makes decisions:wellFormed ask once and brief:openQuestions pass.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/questions-loop.test.js::AC-18603-4: an openQuestion promoted to a one-option decision asks decisions:wellFormed once

testCases.description: No product-owner check changes from ok to failing after an engineer-only edit.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/questions-loop.test.js::AC-18603-5: an engineer-only edit never changes the PO question set
